reader_notes: Short unit, tightly written; the 'force a grip' vs. 'only invite one' contrast is stated in a single explicit sentence, so the item is fair without being trivially findable.

Option D ('the scissors were the only genuinely right-handed tool in the test') is the most tempting wrong answer — a hasty reader may accept it — but the passage does not say the opener and ladle are handedness-neutral, only that they can be worked around by turning the object. The distinction holds on a careful read.
